 "content": "from collections import Counter, deque


def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]
    seen=set(); comps=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if grid[r][c]==bg or (r,c) in seen: continue
            comp={(r,c)}; seen.add((r,c)); q=deque([(r,c)])
            while q:
                y,x=q.popleft()
                for yy,xx in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and grid[yy][xx]!=bg and (yy,xx) not in seen:
                        seen.add((yy,xx)); comp.add((yy,xx)); q.append((yy,xx))
            comps.append(comp)
    motif=max(comps,key=len)
    # Anchor is the marker-equivalent cell: in the motif, the majority color's
    # most central occurrence. (confirmed against demonstration)
    counts=Counter(grid[r][c] for r,c in motif)
    maxcount=max(counts.values())
    cr=(min(r for r,c in motif)+max(r for r,c in motif))/2
    cc=(min(c for r,c in motif)+max(c for r,c in motif))/2
    anchor=min((p for p in motif if counts[grid[p[0]][p[1]]]==maxcount),key=lambda p:(abs(p[0]-cr)+abs(p[1]-cc),p))
    cells=[(r-anchor[0],c-anchor[1],grid[r][c]) for r,c in motif]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for comp in comps:
        if comp==motif or len(comp)!=1: continue
        r,c=next(iter(comp))
        for dr,dc,v in cells:
            y,x=r+dr,c+dc
            if 0<=y<h and 0<=x<w: out[y][x]=v
    return out
"
}
